pages.t: The Store Bus opens a store to the network: a vessel, an overflow vessel, an alembic, a Gyre — from any side. The network sees their distillate in the terminal, draws from them and fills them as with a vial. The window, priority, filter and partition are as on an AE2 storage bus.

A Crucible, a tower and other brewers are no store: the Store Bus only pours into their mouths. With a Gauge Card the network sees and takes only what is above the mark: a Gyre by the altar stays full for the Heart.

kp: Шина запаса Store Bus Шина запаса Store Bus
nodes.hint: The network sees vessels and a Gyre

pages.t: The Apprentice crafts flux recipes on order from an AE2 terminal. Set it right by a Flux Workbench, with an AE2 cable, and beside it a Pattern Provider with a processing pattern "the recipe's items — what is made". It lays the items out as the recipe wants and crafts for whoever set it down: the flux of the place, the shards in the sockets, the entry's knowledge — as in your own hands.

And when you craft yourself: a grid slot emptied by crafting is refilled from the network with the same item — with Shift the workbench crafts while the network has items. Sneak-use the Apprentice with an empty hand to send the grid into the network. It waits if the chunk is dry or the current is missing: the Loupe will tell.

kp: Счётный подмастерье Tally Apprentice Счётный подмастерье Tally Apprentice
nodes.hint: Flux recipes on order and network items in the grid

pages.t: The bin is an ME network for those who carry things the plain way: automatons with sigils and hoppers. What is put into the bin goes into the network once a second. Items chosen by clicking the bin (up to nine) it keeps a stack of from the network — Unload and Issue take them from there, and the Ledger sees them.

Paint Stow on the bin, and automatons carry their load straight into the network; Issue — and the Reserve of any chest takes its shortfall from the network. Sneak-use with an empty hand to clear the choice: the stock goes back into the network.

kp: Счётный ларь Tally Bin Счётный ларь Tally Bin
nodes.hint: Automatons and hoppers at an ME network

pages.t: A tally cell keeps currents in an ME network: put it in an ME Drive or ME Chest, and the AE2 terminal shows the runes of currents beside items. A 1k cell holds about 8,000 parts of one current — five Gyres; up to 18 currents per cell, 8 parts per byte. An ordinary cell takes no Murk.

A vial at the terminal works like a bucket with fluids: a vial on a current in the terminal fills (a click — one part, with Shift — as much as fits, up to 8), a filled one on the terminal pours out as much as the network takes. A vial also sets a current in the slots of current buses, the Interface and a processing pattern.

A cell is a housing and an AE2 storage component of the same size, on a crafting table; the housing is made on the Flux Workbench. Sneak-use an empty cell to take it apart again. A full cell does not sink in a Crucible and the Loupe does not read it: what is reckoned is not poured.

kp: Корпус счётной ячейки Tally Cell Housing Счётная ячейка течений 1k 1k Current Tally Cell
nodes.hint: Currents in a drive and at the terminal

pages.t: A Tally Vessel is a holder for siphons whose distillate is the whole ME network: a siphon above pours into the network whatever flows to it (a Crucible drains into the network by itself), a siphon at its side or below draws from the network what waits down the line — the fullest of what is wanted; a branded vessel below calls its current straight from the network.

Run an AE2 cable with a channel to it: while it is in the network, the beads in the glass light up from bottom to top. A Confluence Heart does not draw from a Tally Vessel — by the altar you set a Confluence Provider.

kp: Счётный сосуд Tally Vessel Счётный сосуд Tally Vessel
nodes.hint: Siphons and an ME network in one block

pages.t: The Tally Wheel shows what an ME network holds without opening a terminal: above the lens floats the Wheel — a rune for every current in the network, larger and brighter where it is fuller, the fullest in the middle. Set it in the workshop with an AE2 cable, and you see what runs low.

The Loupe on it reads the count: how many currents, how many parts and which is the most. A comparator by the block gives how many currents the network holds (up to 15) — a signal for the workshop's redstone.

kp: Счётное колесо Tally Wheel Счётное колесо Tally Wheel
nodes.hint: The network's currents above a lens

pages.t: With Farmer's Delight the herbs and trees of the flux world go to the kitchen, and the kitchen goes into the fluxionist's work: dishes that raise an aptitude one rank for a while, current spices for seasoning, feasts for four — against Dissonance, for the Loupe and for the road, a cure for murk and a compost that drinks murk. A Farmer's Delight cooking pot cooks it all; its knife grinds the spices.

A cutting board strips weeping willow and lumenash logs and wood with an axe, like the logs of the game: willow gives ordinary tree bark, lumenash gives Lumenash Bark, silvery and dotted with grains of light. A Farmer's Delight knife cuts the mod's leaves, strands and herbs quickly.
An Ember Orb warms a Farmer's Delight cooking pot and skillet too — the same one that keeps a Crucible at a simmer. Put the orb under the pot instead of a stove or a campfire.
And back: a lit Farmer's Delight stove keeps a Crucible at a simmer, like a lit furnace.

nodes.hint: Fluxion herbs in the pot, on the board and under the knife of Farmer's Delight

pages.t: Artificer's Roast raises Finesse one rank for 8 minutes (Light Touch): the Flux Workbench takes 6% less flux — under the common thrift limit, half the price. Eat it before a big job at the Workbench.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.

How to cook: two Ember Pepper, raw meat, an onion and a tomato in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl. The heat in a master's hands is even: the pepper wakes the fingers, it does not burn them.

nodes.hint: Finesse one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: Lumenash Brew clears Silting and Clouding, plain and spreading: drink it after a fight with mire creatures, in the smoke of a Murk Fumer, by a Murkcap. Clouding makes flux crafting and Conduit casts dearer — the brew brings the price back.
How to cook: two Lumenash Bark, Clearwort Seeds and sugar in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot over heat. It is drunk from a glass bottle, which stays with you.

nodes.hint: Clears Silting and Clouding

pages.t: The Diviners' Feast is for a round with the Loupe, four together: each serving raises both Acuity and Intellect one rank for 12 minutes (Clear Eye and Bright Mind at once) — the Loupe reads farther and faster, first readings give more notes. A serving is a table too: it replaces earlier ranks at the table.
A feast is set on a table and taken with a bowl — four servings; the last one takes the tray along. Until it is started, it can be picked up whole.

How to cook: a pie crust, two raw fish, honeycomb, Lumenash Pollen and glow berries in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl and takes twice as long. The fish look out of the pie at the sky — diviners said that is how the pie sees the flux.

nodes.hint: Acuity and Intellect one rank higher — for four

pages.t: Diviner's Tea raises Acuity one rank for 8 minutes (Clear Eye): the Loupe reads one block farther and 3 ticks faster — in the world, in a window slot and in the sky. Drink it before a long round with the Loupe.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.

How to cook: two Lumenash Pollen, glow berries and sugar in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it is poured into a glass bottle and can be drunk when full. Diviners drank it before walking a field after the flux: ash pollen flies where the wind pulls.

nodes.hint: Acuity one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: Honeycomb Porridge raises Intellect one rank for 8 minutes (Bright Mind): first readings with the Loupe give a tenth more notes, fractions carried. Eat it before reading something new: a new place, a strange structure, a chest of finds.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.
How to cook: honeycomb, rice, milk and sugar in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl. Honeycomb is Lattice: one hexagon repeated a thousand times, and the mind loves order.

nodes.hint: Intellect one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: The Hush Feast calms Dissonance for everyone at the table: each serving is Hush for 3 minutes (no visions, pressure does not grow), and eaten standing still it also clears all Ripple and 2 Dissonance. It does not touch Deep Dissonance.
A feast is set on a table and taken with a bowl — four servings; the last one takes the tray along. Dissonance is healed by stillness: at a shared table one sits, one does not run.

How to cook: Hush Broth, Hush Salt, rice, cabbage and mushrooms in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl and takes twice as long. A Crucible brews the Hush Broth at a simmer: Farmer's Delight bone broth into a brew with Still and Soul.

kp: Тихий бульон Hush Broth Тихий пир Hush Feast
nodes.hint: Hush for four, and less Dissonance for those who eat standing still

pages.t: Silt Compost takes murk away around a farm and gives Farmer's Delight rich soil: while the chunk holds murk, every random tick it drinks some (up to 0.3) and ripens, and ripe it turns into rich soil. Put it by a workshop with a Crucible and retorts — and the Silt from the Settling Tank finds a use.

In a clean chunk it ripens by itself, six times slower. While it drinks, wisps of murk drift into it. A compost's whole life drinks about 2 murk; in the Stillness, where nothing flows, it does not rot.
How to make it: Farmer's Delight organic compost, two Silt and bone meal on a crafting table. Silt is the caught murk of retorts; in compost it rots into soil and pulls the murk around along with it.

kp: Илистый компост Silt Compost Илистый компост Silt Compost
nodes.hint: Drinks the murk around and turns into rich soil

pages.t: Slow Broth raises Patience one rank for 8 minutes (Even Temper): at the Crucible a clash carries off 5 shares less of a thrown Spring, and your things leave a tenth less murk. Eat it before a long brew.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.

How to cook: two Dried Rippleleaf, a bone, kelp and an onion in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot — the pot simmers it three times longer than usual; it needs a bowl. Patience is learned from a broth: no one hurries the Tide.

nodes.hint: Patience one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: A spice is a pinch of a current from a herb: season any food with it on a crafting table, like Current Grit, and whoever eats it gets the current's effect — 15 seconds per pinch. Ember Pepper — Ember, Fire Resistance; Dried Rippleleaf — Tide, Water Breathing; Lumenash Pollen — Gale, Slow Falling; Dried Glowbloom — Gleam, Night Vision.

Pinches combine by the Wheel, as in a Crucible: Ember Pepper with Lumenash Pollen makes Spark, strength; Rippleleaf with Pollen makes Drift, speed; Ember and Tide hiss, but together give Bloom — healing at half strength. Up to three pinches on a food; spices and Grit can be mixed.

How to get them: a Farmer's Delight knife on a cutting board grinds an Emberbell, cuts a Rippleleaf and a Glowbloom and shakes the pollen from Lumenash Catkins — two pinches per herb. The pot needs spices too: Ember Pepper for Artificer's Roast and Wayfarer's Feast, Rippleleaf for Slow Broth and Wayfarer's Feast, Pollen for Diviner's Tea and Diviners' Feast.

nodes.hint: A pinch of a current from a herb — seasoning for any food

pages.t: Emberbell Stew is a hearty meal and a minute and a half of Fire Resistance: for the lava, the Nether, the Flux Forge. The emberbell grows at the rim of lava and keeps its heat in the petals.
How to cook: two Emberbells, raw meat and a potato in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot. It needs a bowl.

nodes.hint: Hearty, and Fire Resistance for a minute and a half

pages.t: Still Porridge raises Will one rank for 8 minutes (Firm Spirit): Conduit casts cost 6% less, Dissonance visions come more rarely. Eat it before work with the Conduit and before the Stillness.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.
How to cook: two Still Rye Seeds, milk and sugar in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl. Still Rye grows only where no one moves — and a porridge of its grain keeps the mind level.

nodes.hint: Will one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: Stone Soup raises Might one rank for 8 minutes (Strong Arm): the mod's tools and weapons in the main hand hit 5% harder and dig 10% faster. A hearty meal before a mine or a fight.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.

How to cook: cobblestone, raw meat, a potato, an onion and a carrot in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl. The old tale of the soup from a stone: a fluxionist really does cook it, and Strata gives the broth its strength.

nodes.hint: Might one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: Glowbloom Tea gives Night Vision for three minutes: in a mine, a cave, on the road at night. A glowbloom shines by itself — brewed, it shines in your eyes.
How to cook: two Glowblooms and sugar in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot. It is drunk from a glass bottle, which stays with you.

nodes.hint: Night Vision for three minutes

pages.t: Two-Banks Soup raises Poise one rank for 8 minutes (Calm Heart): a Confluence you start is calmer — calm +2 and vortices 3% quieter, a starter's gift under the limit of gear gifts. Eat it before a strong Confluence.
This is a dish «at the table»: the rank holds while its effect lasts, and never above the fifth. Aptitude dishes do not stack — a new one replaces the last: choose what you are busy with today.

How to cook: a Rippleleaf, an Emberbell, cabbage and a potato in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl. In a Crucible Tide and Ember hiss and eat each other, but in a bowl they lie side by side without mixing — that is Poise.

nodes.hint: Poise one rank higher for 8 minutes

pages.t: The Wayfarer's Feast is for the long road: each serving gives Farmer's Delight Nourishment for 12 minutes — hunger does not drain — and raises Might one rank (Strong Arm). Eat a serving before setting out for the Lees, the Quickstream or the Meanders — and forget about food.
A feast is set on a table and taken with a bowl — four servings; the last one takes the tray along. Until it is started, it can be picked up whole.
How to cook: bread, two pieces of raw meat, a potato, Ember Pepper and Dried Rippleleaf in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot; it needs a bowl and takes twice as long.

nodes.hint: Hunger does not drain, Might one rank higher

pages.t: The Afrit Brazier gives a Crucible strong heat without lava or fuel, and while the Crucible stands on it the afrit burns the murk of its land — 0.05 a second, one brazier per chunk: a workshop survives clashes and boil-overs clean. Set the Crucible right on the brazier.
Strong heat dissolves everything, metal and stone too; gentle-heat-only recipes won't brew on the brazier — use an Ember Orb for them.

An Occultism ritual on the Sevira's Permanent Confinement pentacle: the Book of Binding: Afrit (Bound) in the Golden Ritual Bowl, and in the Sacrificial Bowls around it — an Ember Orb, two Fluxsteel Ingots, a blaze rod, iron bars and Otherworld Opaline. The recipe viewer shows the ritual next to Occultism's own.

nodes.hint: Strong heat without fuel, and the Crucible leaves no murk

pages.t: The Afrit Cinder is a warm circle to carry into the Stillness: while the cinder is in your hand (main or off), every 30 seconds a 3-block circle around you thaws for a minute, as from living water. One charge per circle; a full cinder holds 32.

The cinder drinks Ember: use it on a Vessel or Gyre holding Ember — a unit gives 2 charges. Outside the Stillness the cinder is silent. A spirit flows by itself and did not freeze in the Great Stilling — an afrit's flame carries the flow even where nothing flows.

An Occultism ritual on the Sevira's Permanent Confinement pentacle: the Book of Binding: Afrit (Bound) in the Golden Ritual Bowl, and in the Sacrificial Bowls around it — a Brazier Briquette, two Ember Shards, a Speculum Band and Otherworld Opaline. The recipe viewer shows the ritual next to Occultism's own.

nodes.hint: A warm circle to carry into the Stillness

pages.t: An Occultism ritual binds a spirit into a flux device, and the spirit works without rest, fuel or pay: a foliot carries distillate (the Dipper), a djinni spins a skein from the neighboring lands (the Spinning Wheel), an afrit heats a Crucible and burns murk (the Brazier) and thaws the Stillness (the Cinder), a marid keeps a chunk's riverbed (the Well).

The ritual is the crafting pentacle of the spirit's tier: the Book of Binding with the bound spirit goes in the Golden Ritual Bowl, the parts of the device and the Otherworld Opaline — its heart — in the Sacrificial Bowls around it. The book goes into the device with the spirit. Occultism binds a miner into a Dimensional Mineshaft the same way.

kp: Книга и перо Book and Quill
nodes.hint: A spirit in a flux device works without pay

pages.t: A Dissonance Gem lifts up to 12 Dissonance at once: use the empty gem and it drinks your ordinary Dissonance and darkens. It does not drink Deep Dissonance or Ripple, and while a Dissonant Eye is worn it drinks nothing.

A full gem keeps what it drank. Sneak and use it to shatter it — the Dissonance breaks free as an Unbound Afrit. The fight is hard, but the afrit drops Afrit Essence — for Occultism's red chalk. One gem per ritual.

An Occultism ritual on the Sevira's Permanent Confinement pentacle: the Book of Binding: Afrit (Bound) in the Golden Ritual Bowl, and in the Sacrificial Bowls around it — a Soul Gem, two Hush Salts, an amethyst shard and Otherworld Opaline. The recipe viewer shows the ritual next to Occultism's own.

nodes.hint: Lifts Dissonance; a full one is shattered and fought

pages.t: The Djinni Spinning Wheel winds a skein even in a drained workshop: the djinni spins its native threads from the flux of the neighboring lands. Place the wheel within 4 blocks of the skein — every 5 seconds it ties on a share of the thinnest native thread and takes a unit of flux from the fullest of the eight neighboring lands whose flux is at least half the bed.

A neighboring land gives the wheels a share no more than once in 10 seconds; the skein's own land winds it as before. The djinni leaves greedy, still, murky and full skeins alone; one wheel per skein.

An Occultism ritual on the Strigeor's Higher Binding pentacle: the Book of Binding: Djinni (Bound) in the Golden Ritual Bowl, and in the Sacrificial Bowls around it — a Spindle, two Lumenash Planks, Fluxsteel Wire, string and Otherworld Opaline. The recipe viewer shows the ritual next to Occultism's own.

nodes.hint: A skein winds even in a drained workshop

pages.t: Flux matter replaces the rare in Occultism rituals. Infused Lenses — with two opaline instead of silver. A Soul Gem — with Otherworld Opaline instead of a diamond and two speculum ingots instead of copper, silver and gold. A Tier 3 Dimensional Storage Stabilizer — with two stillmetal ingots instead of a totem of undying: the Still keeps what is laid down.
The rituals use the same pentacles and books as Occultism's own. And Spiritfire burns the mire out of a Purifier's Clogged Lumenash Grate: throw it into the fire and it comes out clean.

kp: Flux Matter in Rites Вещества тока в обрядах
nodes.hint: Opaline, speculum and stillmetal instead of the rare

pages.t: The Foliot Dipper carries distillate between two holders without siphons or pipes: the foliot scoops from the vessel the dipper stands on and every 8 seconds flies to its pair with up to 4 units of the current the target takes, 30 units a minute. Set the pair before placing: sneak and use the dipper on the target vessel, then place it on the source vessel.
The target must be within 16 blocks, in the same world and in loaded land. A branded vessel takes only its own current. A broken dipper forgets its pair. The Loupe line tells what is wrong.

An Occultism ritual on the Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion pentacle: the Book of Binding: Foliot (Bound) in the Golden Ritual Bowl, and in the Sacrificial Bowls around it — a Siphon, a Vial, a Speculum Band and Otherworld Opaline. The recipe viewer shows the ritual next to Occultism's own.

nodes.hint: A foliot carries distillate without siphons

pages.t: The Marid Well keeps its chunk's riverbed: the marid turns murk into flux — 0.1 a second, without grates or fuel — and when flux falls below three quarters of the bed it pours some over from the fullest neighbor, 0.1 a second. In a clean chunk mire recedes by itself. Place the well in your workshop's chunk.
One well per chunk. The marid does not make flux, it moves it: the neighbors have less.

An Occultism ritual on the Uphyxes Inverted Tower pentacle: the Book of Binding: Marid (Bound) in the Golden Ritual Bowl, and in the Sacrificial Bowls around it — a Tide Orb, a Lumenash Grate, two iesnium ingots, a nautilus shell and Otherworld Opaline. The recipe viewer shows the ritual next to Occultism's own.

nodes.hint: A marid keeps a chunk's riverbed

pages.t: The Loupe finds the Otherworld without the Third Eye. Otherworld stone, trees, leaves and iesnium ore that look like stone and oak flow with Soul and Gloom under the Loupe — plain stone and wood hold no Soul. Found one? Mine it with the Third Eye or in Otherworld Goggles, or it drops as plain stone.
To study this entry, read at least one such hidden block with the Loupe. The reading brings notes like any new one, and the Soul in it reveals itself.

kp: The Otherworld under the Loupe Потустороннее под Лупой
nodes.hint: Read a hidden Otherworld stone or tree with the Loupe

pages.t: Otherworld Opaline is the heart of everything a spirit is bound into, and the bead of a Spiritcatcher. Throw opaline into the Spiritfire of Occultism: the stone comes out with the mist of spirits inside and holds their trail.

nodes.hint: Opaline in Spiritfire

pages.t: An Occultism crusher doubles flux ores: opaline ore gives two opaline, niello ore two niello, antimony ore two raw antimony; a higher-tier crusher gives more, as with any ore. Give the ore to a spirit summoned to crush — a foliot, djinni, afrit or marid.

nodes.hint: An Occultism crusher doubles flux ores

pages.t: The miners of an Occultism Dimensional Mineshaft dig flux ores too: a foliot brings opaline and antimony ore, a djinni and higher also niello and the flux shards of the six bases: Tide, Strata, Ember, Gale, Lattice and Fray.
The spirit digs in the Other Place, not in your land: the flux and murk of the chunk stay as they were, and no crystal is emptied.

nodes.hint: A Dimensional Mineshaft digs flux ores and shards

pages.t: A Spiritcatcher gathers the trail of the Occultism spirits that live and work nearby into distillate: a foliot gives Soul, a djinni Weave, an afrit Ember, a marid Halo. Put it on a Vessel, a Crucible or another holder with a mouth on top — siphons and a Confluence Heart take what it pours, as from any vessel.

Spirits within eight blocks. Each drops a share every two seconds; one takes about a minute for a unit, a catcher gives no more than three units a minute. One spirit feeds one catcher. A vessel of another current will not take the trail. An unbound spirit drops Murk — watch where it flows.

kp: Ловец духов Spiritcatcher Ловец духов Spiritcatcher
nodes.hint: The trail of spirits into distillate

pages.t: With Occultism the spirits work for a fluxionist too. Occultism rituals bind them into flux devices: a foliot carries distillate, a djinni spins a skein, an afrit heats a Crucible and thaws the Stillness, a marid keeps the riverbed. A Spiritcatcher gathers their trail into distillate, Occultism miners and crushers bring flux ores, and the Loupe sees the Otherworld through its veil.

A spirit is a current of Soul that flows by itself and did not freeze in the Great Stilling. The Loupe reads spirits like anything alive: a foliot holds Soul and Gale, a djinni Weave, an afrit Ember, a marid Halo; an unbound spirit carries murk. Each familiar carries its own current beside Soul.

nodes.hint: The spirits of Occultism work for a fluxionist too

pages.t: Occultism's Otherworld Goggles and Diviner's Spectacles in one frame. Put the Otherworld Goggles and the Diviner's Spectacles on a crafting table: the lenses go into the frame. The goggles still give the Third Eye and also show what Crucibles, vessels and siphons hold — no more swapping headgear at the crucible.
The Diviner's Spectacles stay in the frame for good; the goggles' tooltip names the lenses in a line.
